notes_for_editor: Built year: 1940 in the register, firelookout.com, the Forest Lookouts page and the Idaho list; the Idaho News 6 feature (undated in the cached copy) says 1941. Elevation differs across sources (register 6,706 ft, Idaho list 6694 ft, news feature about 6,800 ft); the record's 2044 m follows the register. Staffing as_of is 2024, the latest known-staff entry on the Idaho list (2021 Brig Malessa, 2022 Ezekiel Morphis, 2024 Stuart Morris); the 2021 evidence previously quoted the 2024 name and is corrected. The news feature is undated, so current staffing is unconfirmed. No source states an access level, so access is omitted. Record kind two_story and elevation are consistent with the sources.
